purpose: Acquire an identifiable MacBook two-speaker to Pixel two-microphone H[k], noise covariance, repeat stability, and randomized two-stream probe under fixed total digital sample power.
hard_prohibitions: Do not create the two H columns with separate player launches.
Do not downmix, beamform, reorder, or discard either Pixel input channel.
Do not infer input independence from Android channel count alone.
Do not compare equal amplitude on both speakers to one speaker as the primary power class.
Do not label endpoint volume and sample amplitude as calibrated SPL.
Do not use payload decisions, CRC results, or expected payload bytes for channel selection.

transmitter.required_audio_session: One continuously running two-channel output unit for the entire probe. Both channel buffers begin on the same render sample timeline.
transmitter.sample_format: float32 or int16 with the exact conversion recorded

receiver.required_capture: One uninterrupted, interleaved two-channel 48 kHz PCM capture retaining original sample order.
receiver.encoding: PCM_16BIT or PCM_FLOAT, recorded in the completed manifest

waveform.real_waveform: Hermitian symmetry; DC and Nyquist are zero.

papr_limiter.algorithm: deterministic iterative clipping and active-bin filtering
papr_limiter.forbidden: No per-capture normalization after the drive class is frozen.

timeline.label: stereo_sync
timeline.use: shared origin and output-channel mapping; not H estimation

timeline.label: orthogonal_matrix_probe

tx_code.per_bin_pilot: deterministic BPSK from pilot_seed; identical active-bin support for both outputs

timeline.estimator: For each two-symbol group and bin, solve Y=HX using the known 2x2 orthogonal code; retain all eight H estimates before averaging.

timeline.label: randomized_tx0_simo_control
timeline.tx0: independently seeded QPSK control stream on every active bin at total control power P
timeline.receiver: Per-bin noise-whitened SIMO; retain actual bits, LLRs, EVM, and symbol estimates.

timeline.label: randomized_tx1_simo_control
timeline.tx1: independently seeded QPSK control stream on every active bin at total control power P
timeline.receiver: Per-bin noise-whitened SIMO; retain actual bits, LLRs, EVM, and symbol estimates.

timeline.label: randomized_two_stream_probe
timeline.tx0: independently seeded QPSK stream 0 on every active bin
timeline.tx1: independently seeded QPSK stream 1 on every active bin
timeline.receiver: Per-bin noise-whitened MMSE; retain actual known bits, actual LLRs, EVM, and decoded symbol estimates for both physical streams.
timeline.note: This unprecoded physical-port probe is a conservative mode-2 GMI test. A later preloaded-SVD probe requires a separately preregistered feedback-burst experiment.

timeline.label: tail_silence
timeline.use: post-signal noise witness and protection from the known macOS stream-end fade

primary.label: fixed-sum-digital-sample-power
primary.control: One speaker carries total mean active-signal sample power P; the other is exactly zero.
primary.matrix_and_two_stream: Each speaker carries P/2 mean active-signal sample power.
required_report: mean square per speaker by timeline segment
sum mean square across speakers by segment
sample peak and clipped-sample count per speaker

separate_optional_diagnostic.label: equal-per-speaker-plus-3dB-total
separate_optional_diagnostic.restriction: Requires a separate manifest and must never be pooled with the primary class.

geometry_cells_in_acquisition_order.description: Pixel face-up on 0.5-inch soft cloth above the MacBook function-key area, in the retained optimal position.
Pixel centerline three feet from the MacBook speaker baseline; exact xyz coordinates and orientation photographed and measured.
Three-foot range with a preregistered 18-inch lateral offset from the MacBook centerline; exact xyz coordinates and orientation photographed and measured.

per_repeat_sequence: Record preflight route signature, OS volume, source, APK/build identity, and clock timestamps.
Start the two-channel Pixel capture before playback and preserve its original interleaving.
Start one phase-continuous Mac stereo render; do not stop or reopen the output unit between speakers or segments.
Record postflight route signature and reject the repeat on any route/source/channel-map change.
Hash raw capture, rendered stereo PCM, completed manifest, and analyzer version before examining candidate metrics.
Alternate the sign of the tx1 Walsh row on even repeat IDs as a channel-map and estimator control; canonicalize it in analysis.

digital_render: Both output channels have the declared sample count and shared origin.
Each Walsh row is orthogonal to the other to numerical tolerance <= 1e-12 before PCM quantization.
Wrong-column energy during single-column digital unit checks is <= -80 dBFS.
receiver_rows: Report zero-lag and lag-optimized correlation during noise, sync, matrix, and payload segments.
Reject undocumented Android mixing, channel reorder, or non-direct mapping.
Do not reject high acoustic correlation alone; independence is a routing/sample question, while spatial rank is measured from H[k].
clock_and_phase: Estimate timing, CFO, and SRO only from sync and known matrix probes.
Retain one fitted timing/CFO/SRO correction per capture and its residuals.
Repeat coherence must be >= 0.95 and p90 residual phase SD <= 15 degrees after correction.
p90 abs(H) coefficient of variation must be <= 0.15 over held-out repeats.
channel_validity: Reject any capture with source clipping, Mac output peak violation, missing samples, or a discontinuity marker.
Reject if the measured delay support invalidates CP=240 for this estimator; changing CP requires a new preregistration.
Estimate full per-bin 2x2 receiver noise covariance from both silence intervals and report diagonal loading.

minimum_outputs_per_repeat: raw-pixel-stereo.pcm or lossless WAV with format metadata
H-repeats.npz with eight within-capture group estimates

staged_minimum.first_action: Acquire near-01 only and run integrity checks before exposing the remaining cells.
staged_minimum.near_field_feasibility_minimum: Five valid near-field repeats establish only the near-field geometry result.
staged_minimum.full_rank11a_minimum: Fifteen valid captures: five whole matrices in each of the three declared geometries.
staged_minimum.promotion_requirement: At least two geometry cells must independently clear every gate and predict >=1.35x setup-inclusive 1 MiB net goodput over best-speaker/SIMO.

artifact_claim_class: New acquisitions are measured OTA. Synthetic fixture outputs remain synthetic; summaries without raw capture replay remain insufficient.
